protocol.scope: 16 development continuations; no robustness qualification or goal-completion gate
protocol.ground: 40 m box, standard gravity and engine contact law
protocol.baseline: the game's Stand up (step-up, STEP_UP's settings); standard support recovery as the built-in comparison
protocol.anatomy: Warrior/Rogue game bodies on the run's legs (owner-run-body); empty or right-hand club; unchanged muscles
protocol.prefix: 240 standing steps, two 60 N s shoves 24 steps apart, saved after first recovery takeover; optimized prefix shared by all candidates
protocol.clock: original takeover, including shared prefix; never reset at checkpoint
protocol.success: zero external actuation throughout; existing physical upright/loaded two-foot support and quiet 0.5 s; actual host handover, 2 s standing then 1 s walking at least 0.1 m; bounded efforts
protocol.reporting: all cases retained; show 6/12/35 s counts; failures infinity in medians; no new substantial-improvement threshold
protocol.changes: owner agreement required before changing evaluator, baseline, cases, body configurations or criteria
